dedupe_keys.name: nls topographic database maastotietokanta finland including buildings

description: The Topographic Database of the National Land Survey of Finland is the nationwide vector description of the terrain, whose main feature groups are the transport network, buildings and structures, administrative boundaries, place names, land use, waters and elevation. Building features carry a use code (käyttötarkoitus) explained in a published code list. The database is updated from aerial imagery, laser scanning and data from other producers in close cooperation with municipalities; roads and names are updated continuously, administrative boundaries and buildings yearly, and other features map sheet by map sheet every five to ten years. Coverage: all of Finland. Access: download as ESRI Shapefile, GML or GeoPackage through the Karttapaikka file service, with the GML schema and code lists published. Licence: CC BY 4.0, citing the licensor, dataset name and delivery date; free. Caveats: it is a topographic product, so buildings have footprints and use codes but not the construction years, floor areas or dwellings of the population register; features may be missing or obsolete between updates. Simulation uses are a free national building footprint layer for exposure mapping, service catchment and digital twin base maps. Related records: the Helsinki 3D city models and the Finnish residential material inventory.
